name: QiYi Chips Cube 3x3 (Magnetic)
description: The QiYi Chips Cube 3x3 (Magnetic) is a beginner-friendly magnetic speed cube from QiYi's children's series, built around a bold two-tone chip-style pattern that makes it easy to track your turns while you learn. Magnetic positioning gives it a stable, controlled feel that traditional non-magnetic kids' cubes can't match.
features: Built for first-time cubers: A simplified, bold chip-style color pattern lowers the learning threshold so kids can follow their turns without getting lost.
Sized for small hands: At 55.5 mm, it's easy for little hands to grip and turn comfortably.
Fun to look at: The two-tone chip grouping and bright, easy-to-distinguish colors keep kids engaged while they practice.
Magnetic positioning: Adds stability to each turn and helps the cube align so it doesn't wobble or catch mid-solve.
Frosted surface: A matte finish that resists scratches, cuts glare, and stays fingerprint-free through heavy play.
Bright color scheme: Colors are vivid and clearly separated, making it simple for children to tell pieces apart at a glance.
